name: Face cleanser
definition: rinse-off product made to wash the skin of the face.
notes: Olive Young Cleansers tab and Lagom Cellup Micro Foam Cleanser; Sephora AU Cleanser & Exfoliator

name: Cleansing oil
definition: oil-based cleanser that dissolves makeup and sebum and emulsifies on rinsing.
notes: Anua Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil sold under Cleansers

name: Toner
definition: watery leave-on product applied after cleansing to prepare the skin (a toner pad is a toner with format = pad).
notes: Olive Young lists Toners as a formulation (226) and MEDIHEAL Toner Pad; Sephora AU Toner category

name: Serum
definition: concentrated leave-on treatment applied before moisturising (ampoule and essence are formulations).
notes: Serums sold by name (Anua, Torriden, S.NATURE); ampoule is a separate formulation filter

name: Cream
definition: thick leave-on moisturiser for any area (face, eye, hand, foot, body by `area`).
notes: Creams sold for face; Olive Young Moisturizers tab, cream formulation 180

name: Lotion or emulsion [乳液]
definition: fluid leave-on moisturiser for any area.
notes: Japanese retailer lists 乳液/エマルジョン (emulsion, milk) as one category of 82 items

name: Lip balm
definition: solid or soft balm with no colour that softens and protects the lips.
notes: Sephora AU Lips menu has Lip Balm apart from Lip Gloss and Lipstick

name: Body oil or massage oil
definition: oil applied to the skin to moisturise it or for massage.
notes: The Body Shop sells massage oils and dry body oils together in one collection

name: Sheet mask
definition: single-use sheet soaked in a treatment, laid on the face.
notes: Olive Young Face Masks tab with Format filter Sheet/Patch (135); mask sold as 10 sheets

name: Sleeping mask
definition: leave-on mask worn overnight.
notes: Cult Beauty Overnight Face Masks category with LANEIGE Water Sleeping Mask

name: Sunscreen
definition: product applied to the skin to protect it from UV, any area and any format (stick, lotion, spray).
notes: Olive Young Suncare tab and SPF filter; Sephora AU Sun Care

name: Skin repellent
definition: insect repellent applied to the skin.
notes: MEC sells PiActive DEET FREE Insect Repellent Lotion 120ml; page extract is thin

name: Cotton pad
definition: pad of cotton or fibre for applying or removing skin-care products and makeup.
notes: KIKO sells Make Up Remover Cleansing Pads of 100 percent cotton, washable; reusable form

name: Foundation
definition: tinted product that evens the colour of the face (cushion is a format).
notes: Foundation in Sephora AU Face menu and House of Beauty Face (62 items)

name: Concealer
definition: high-coverage tinted product that hides spots, marks and shadows.
notes: Concealer & Corrector at Sephora AU; House of Beauty Concealer (55); Hourglass Vanish Airbrush Concealer

name: Blush
definition: coloured powder, cream or liquid that adds colour to the cheeks.
notes: Blush at Sephora AU and House of Beauty (35); Hourglass Ambient Lighting Blush

name: Primer
definition: product applied before makeup to prepare the skin for it.
notes: Sephora AU Face Primer and House of Beauty Primer (35)

name: Setting spray
definition: spray applied over makeup to fix it.
notes: Sephora AU Setting & Finishing Spray; House of Beauty Makeup Spray (25)

name: Skin paint or powder
definition: powder or paint applied to the skin as colour, including kumkum and sindoor.
notes: Parul Garg Signature Sindoor Pack sells liquid and powder sindoor (kumkum)

name: Mascara
definition: coloured product brushed onto the lashes.
notes: Mascara at Sephora AU, House of Beauty (95) and Hourglass Unlocked Instant Extensions Mascara

name: Eyeliner
definition: pencil, liquid or gel that draws a line along the lash line.
notes: Eyeliner at Sephora AU and House of Beauty (77)

name: Eyebrow gel
definition: tinted or clear gel that shapes and sets the brows.
notes: LH cosmetics Tinted brow gel, product type Brow gel

name: False eyelashes
definition: strip or individual artificial lashes attached to the lash line.
notes: False Eyelashes at Sephora AU; House of Beauty Lashes (226)

name: Lash and brow serum
definition: leave-on serum applied to lashes or brows to condition them.
notes: UKLASH sells Eyebrow Growth Serum and Lash Growth Serum

name: Lipstick
definition: coloured product applied to the lips (gloss and liquid forms are formats).
notes: Lipstick, Lip Stain & Tint and Lip Gloss listed as separate Sephora AU lip items

name: Nail polish
definition: coloured or clear lacquer painted on the nails.
notes: Nail Polish, Base & Top Coat at Sephora AU

name: Artificial nails
definition: press-on or glued nail tips or covers worn over the natural nail.
notes: Artificial Nails category at Sephora AU, apart from Nail Polish

name: Makeup brush
definition: brush made for applying makeup.
notes: Makeup Brushes (466) in House of Beauty with foundation, eyeshadow, blending types

name: Eyelash curler
definition: hand tool that clamps and curls the lashes.
notes: Eyelash Curler (5) listed in House of Beauty Eyes menu

name: Shampoo
definition: rinse-off product that washes the hair and scalp.
notes: JVN and K-time sell shampoos by name

name: Conditioner
definition: rinse-off or leave-in product that softens and detangles hair after washing.
notes: JVN sells conditioners (Embody, Nurture, Revive) beside shampoos

name: Hair mask [Haarkur]
definition: intensive treatment left on the hair for a time and rinsed.
notes: Schuback Haarkur & Haarmaske category; Sisley Hair Rituel masks

name: Hair dye
definition: product that changes the colour of the hair.
notes: Semi-permanent hair colours (Adore, Manic Panic, Pravana, Wella) at MyHaircare

name: Hairspray
definition: spray that holds a hairstyle in place.
notes: Living Proof Hairspray collection with Style Lab Flex Hairspray

name: Wig
definition: full head covering of real or synthetic hair worn as hair.
notes: WigSalon Shop Wigs by length, cap type, hair type; Luvme sells human hair wigs

name: Hairpiece
definition: partial piece of hair (extension, topper, fall) attached to the wearer's hair.
notes: WigSalon Hairpieces: toppers, ponies, fringes, extensions

name: Flat iron
definition: heated plates that straighten hair by clamping it.
notes: Lyko category Hair Straighteners (136)

name: Curling iron
definition: heated barrel around which hair is wound to curl it.
notes: Lyko category Curling Irons (119); Crimping Irons (33)

name: Hair dryer
definition: appliance that blows heated air to dry hair.
notes: Lyko category Hair Dryers (144)

name: Hot brush
definition: heated round or paddle brush that dries or styles hair.
notes: Lyko category Heat Brushes (95) with ghd Rise Volumising Hot Brush

name: Hairbrush
definition: brush with bristles or pins for brushing hair.
notes: Tangle Teezer and Denman hairbrushes; Ulta Hair Brushes & Combs

name: Comb
definition: toothed strip for combing and parting hair.
notes: Tangle Teezer Wide Tooth Comb; Denman D28 Wide Tooth Detangler Comb

name: Hair tie
definition: plain elastic band that holds hair in place.
notes: Emi Jay scrunchies sold as ponytail holders; Wikipedia lists hair elastics

name: Plain hair clip
definition: plain clip or grip that holds hair, without jewels or ornament.
notes: Claw clips and barrettes at The Hair Edit and Emi Jay; plain versus ornamented not split on pages

name: Fine fragrance (alcohol-based)
definition: fragrance in an alcohol base, sprayed or splashed on the body.
notes: Chanel Eau de Parfum category and Maison Francis Kurkdjian Eau de parfum; Fragrantica Diptyque Eaux de Parfum

name: Solid perfume
definition: fragrance set in a wax or balm base, rubbed on the skin.

name: Perfume oil
definition: fragrance in an oil base with no alcohol, applied to the skin.
notes: Attar Emporium alcohol-free fragrance oils; Attar Mist attar perfume oils

name: Body mist
definition: light fragrance spray made for the body.
notes: Bath & Body Works Body Sprays & Mists category of Fine Fragrance Mist (87 items)

name: Hair perfume
definition: fragrance made to be sprayed on the hair.
notes: Diptyque Orpheon Hair mist 30 ml; L'Eau Papier Hair Mist on Fragrantica
